entities.evidence: Company's own site and LinkedIn both use 'Vermillio'; no established Simplified Chinese name found in public snippets, so keep the English brand. Transcript auto-caption 'Vermilion' is a demonstrably wrong variant.
LinkedIn and TIME both identify Dan Neely as Vermillio's co-founder and CEO; no reliable Chinese display form found, so keep English.
Businesswire and Music Business Worldwide confirm Sony Music Entertainment as lead investor; Chinese media commonly render it 索尼音乐. Not mentioned in the transcript itself, only in public context.
Two independent reports name DNS Capital as co-lead of Vermillio's Series A; no established Chinese name found.

clip_research.source_claim: When we started this business back in 2020, there were about 19,000 deep-fake creators... Today, there were about a trillion.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public deepfake research (Regula, GAO, Surfshark) tracks rising deepfake incidents and fraud losses but does not report a creator count of 19,000 in 2020 or a trillion today.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The claimed jump from 19,000 deepfake creators in 2020 to about a trillion today is far larger than any figure in public deepfake research, and the 'trillion' likely conflates creators with content items or scans.

evidence.fact: Dan Neely says Vermillio started thinking about the problem in 2020 when there were about 19,000 deepfake creators, versus about a trillion today.
Neely distinguishes copyright from likeness, describing likeness as voice, movement and name that make up an individual.

evidence.fact: TIME reports Vermillio scans 99.9% of the internet, about 2 trillion items yearly, to identify AI-generated likenesses.
Regula's 2024 deepfake report tracks incident growth but gives no 19,000-to-trillion creator figure.

forbidden_claims: Do not state that there are literally one trillion deepfake creators.
Do not claim Vermillio's figures are independently verified.
Do not claim Vermillio has a Chinese name or Chinese operations.
Do not claim Sony Music or DNS Capital were mentioned in the interview.

notes: No established Simplified Chinese name was found for Vermillio, Dan Neely, DNS Capital or TraceID; keep English to avoid inventing phonetic renderings.
Sony Music Entertainment and DNS Capital appear only in public funding context, not in the clip transcript.
The 19,000-to-trillion deepfake figure is the speaker's own claim and should be attributed, not presented as verified fact.
